comment: `prisma/**` is excluded by pattern, not by filename.
It used to list `prisma/seed.ts` exactly. Adding a second script there
(`seed-meal-plans.ts`) pulled it into the build, which widened the
inferred rootDir from `src` to the package root — so the output moved
from `dist/main.js` to `dist/src/main.js` and the deploy script's
`[ -f dist/main.js ]` guard stopped the release. Nothing errored; the
build just quietly emitted somewhere else. A pattern means the next
seed script cannot do this again.
